en.name: Spelt, whole grain
en.summary: Spelt is an ancient hulled wheat: each grain grows inside a tough husk that has to be threshed off before you can cook it, and what reaches the shop is almost always already dehulled — long, pointed, reddish berries with the bran and germ intact. Sealed in a cupboard they keep about 6 months, and 12 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F).
en.pantry: Roughly 6 months in a jar that seals, kept cool, dark and away from the cooker. The hull that protected the grain in the field is gone by the time you get it, so the jar is doing that job now. The clock is set by the oil in the germ: the starch would last years, but the oil turns and takes with it the sweet, nutty flavour that is the whole reason for choosing spelt over ordinary wheat. Chew a raw berry occasionally as a test — a fresh one is milky and sweet, a stale one is flat with a slight bitterness at the back of the mouth. Berries outlast spelt flour by a wide margin, which is the argument for milling your own if you bake.
en.fridge: There is no published refrigerator figure for whole spelt, so this page does not offer one. An airtight jar in the fridge is nonetheless a sensible place for an opened bag in a hot, humid kitchen: the cold slows oxidation and nothing can get in. The container has to close properly, because grain absorbs the smell of whatever else is on the shelf, and you should open it only once the jar has stopped feeling cold to the touch.
en.freezer: Twelve months at −18 °C (0 °F), twice the cupboard figure, in an airtight tub or a doubled bag with the air squeezed out. Freezing is the right call for a big bag and it settles any question of insect eggs in the same move. Spelt berries need a long simmer whether or not they have been frozen, so tip them into the pan still frozen. Safety at −18 °C is open-ended; the 12 months describes flavour.
spoilage: A bitter or paint-like smell from rancid germ oil.
A musty, damp smell, or grains clumping together.
Webbing, small moths or fine dust in the jar.
Berries that stay hard in the centre however long they simmer.
tips: Buy whole berries rather than flour if you want spelt to keep.
Soak the berries overnight to cut the cooking time.
Freeze a big bag on the day of purchase.
Smell the grain before cooking; rancidity does not show.

faq.q: How long does whole spelt keep?
faq.a: About 6 months airtight in a cool, dark cupboard, or 12 months at −18 °C (0 °F).
Yes, 12 months at −18 °C in an airtight container, and they can be cooked straight from frozen.

faq.q: Does spelt flour keep as long as the whole grain?
faq.a: No. Milling exposes the germ oil to air, so spelt flour goes rancid considerably faster.

zh.name: 全粒斯佩爾特小麥
zh.summary: 斯佩爾特小麥是一種古老的帶殼小麥：每一粒都長在堅韌的外殼裡，要先脫殼才能煮，而市面上買到的幾乎都已經脫好殼——細長帶尖、偏紅褐色，麩皮與胚芽完整。密封放櫥櫃約 6 個月，−18 °C 冷凍 12 個月。
zh.pantry: 用關得緊的罐子，放陰涼避光、遠離爐台的地方，大約 6 個月。在田裡保護過它的那層外殼，到你手上時已經沒了，現在做這件事的是罐子。倒數的是胚芽裡的油脂：澱粉放好幾年都沒事，但油一變質，那股讓人願意捨棄一般小麥去買它的甜堅果香就沒了。偶爾生嚼一粒當作檢查：新鮮的嚼起來是奶香帶甜的，放久的則平淡，後段還有一點苦。整粒比斯佩爾特麵粉耐放得多，這也是有烘焙習慣的人值得自己磨粉的理由。
zh.fridge: 全粒斯佩爾特沒有公布的冷藏期限，本頁因此不給。不過在濕熱的廚房裡，裝密封罐放冰箱仍然是合理的安排：低溫拖慢氧化，蟲也進不來。罐子必須關得緊，因為穀物會把同一層架上其他東西的味道吸進去；要等罐子摸起來不再冰涼，才打開它。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 12 個月，是櫥櫃數字的兩倍，裝密封盒或套兩層袋擠出空氣。大包裝就該這樣處理，同一個動作也順手解決蟲卵。斯佩爾特麥粒不管有沒有凍過都得久煮，所以凍著直接倒進鍋子就好。−18 °C 下的安全性沒有終點，12 個月說的是風味。
spoilage: 聞到胚芽油走油耗後的苦味或油漆味。
有潮霉味，或麥粒結成塊。
罐內出現絲網、小蛾或細粉屑。
不管燉多久，中心還是硬的。
tips: 想讓它耐放就買整粒，不要買麵粉。
煮之前泡水一晚，可以縮短烹煮時間。
大包裝買回來當天就冷凍。
煮之前先聞；油耗是看不出來的。

faq.q: 全粒斯佩爾特小麥可以放多久？
faq.a: 密封、陰涼避光的櫥櫃約 6 個月，或 −18 °C 冷凍 12 個月。

faq.q: 斯佩爾特麥粒可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 可以，−18 °C 下密封容器 12 個月，而且能直接從冷凍下鍋煮。

faq.q: 斯佩爾特麵粉和整粒一樣耐放嗎？
faq.a: 不一樣。研磨把胚芽油脂暴露在空氣中，麵粉走油耗的速度快得多。
